def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Simple driving: try to approach the enemy while avoiding walls
    # Check if we can drive and aren't already at rest
    if not me.can_drive or me.airborne or me.on_side:
        return None
    
    # Calculate direction to enemy
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    target_angle = math.atan2(dy, dx)  # angle in radians from me to enemy
    
    # Convert to degrees relative to me's heading
    # bearing_to would be ideal but let's calculate manually
    angle_diff = (target_angle * 180 / math.pi - me.heading + 540) % 360 - 180
    
    # If enemy is mostly ahead, drive forward; if to side, turn
    if abs(angle_diff) < 30:  # Enemy roughly ahead
        return (1, 1)  # Full speed ahead
    elif abs(angle_diff) < 90:  # Enemy to side
        # Turn toward enemy
        if angle_diff > 0:
            return (-1, 1)  # Turn left
        else:
            return (1, -1)  # Turn right
    else:  # Enemy behind
        return (-1, -1)  # Back up

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
    # Default: no weapon actions
    return None

def drive(me, enemy, arena):
    # Simple driving: try to approach the enemy while avoiding walls
    # Check if we can drive and aren't already at rest
    if not me.can_drive or me.airborne or me.on_side:
        return None
    
    # Calculate direction to enemy
    dx = enemy.x - me.x
    dy = enemy.y - me.y
    target_angle = math.atan2(dy, dx)  # angle in radians from me to enemy
    
    # Convert to degrees relative to me's heading
    # bearing_to would be ideal but let's calculate manually
    angle_diff = (target_angle * 180 / math.pi - me.heading + 540) % 360 - 180
    
    # If enemy is mostly ahead, drive forward; if to side, turn
    if abs(angle_diff) < 30:  # Enemy roughly ahead
        return (1, 1)  # Full speed ahead
    elif abs(angle_diff) < 90:  # Enemy to side
        # Turn toward enemy
        if angle_diff > 0:
            return (-1, 1)  # Turn left
        else:
            return (1, -1)  # Turn right
    else:  # Enemy behind
        return (-1, -1)  # Back up

def weapons(me, enemy, arena):
